feeding_claim.verbatim: At no time do we offer our cattle any grain.

notes: Family farm near Jacksonville in central Illinois, started in 2016 by the Bland family. Checked the products, about and beef pages; the find us and contact pages would not load. The cattle get no grain, only pasture and farm-raised hay in winter, and the beef page calls it 100% grass-fed because no grain is ever given. Chickens have access to grazing pasture and eggs are sold as pasture raised. Orders are placed online for weekly Tuesday delivery or self-serve pickup from a porch freezer at the farm, and there is a monthly meat box subscription. The about page says the farm has supplied local grocery stores since 2018. Delivery area, current farmers markets and bulk shares were not confirmed. The farm also sells garden produce. The site calls the farm organic; organic labels are left to the USDA matching script.
